groups.contentHtml:
Local Walks
Village walk McGrady Falls Trai Coal Mine walk
Length 6km 12 km 13.5km
Level of difficulty Easy Easy
Attractions - The (centrally located)
- A with a good view 		- A below the falls
- Lots of 		- Signs about the of the mine

analyses.content: 录音中明确评价McGrady Falls整体上是“moderate”（中等难度），直接对应表格中的难度等级。
你可能会听到“a bit difficult”或“easy”，但前者只是局部路况，后者说的是另一条路线Village Walk，一定要注意主语和整体评价。
So are those two more difficult as well as longer? Well, the Village Walk's classified as easy. McGrady Falls has some climbing, which is a bit difficult, but overall it's moderate.
录音中的“right in the middle”完美同义替换题干的“centrally located”，紧跟其后出现的“museum”即为答案。
你可能会填“village”，但它是整个路线的大范围起始点，并非位于中心的具体游览点。

And, um, what's special about each of the walks? I mean, what interesting things could I see? Well, with the Village Walk, you start off in the village. It's really nice, and right in the middle there's the museum. That's very popular. It tells you a bit about the background to the region.
录音提到在“park”你可以“look at the view”，这同义替换了题目里的“with a good view”。
你可能会被后面补充的“mountains”干扰，但山是你在这个地点看到的景色，并非带有好景色的主语地点。

Then at the edge of the village, there's a park where you can have a rest and look at the view before you set off on the walk back. It's pretty impressive on a clear day. You get a fantastic view of the mountains.
录音中的“just under the falls”同义替换题目中的“below the falls”，其后的核心名词“pool”就是答案。
如果跟听时只抓取了原词“falls”，你可能会忽略掉真正需要填写的具体水域名词“pool”。
Can I do that at the McGrady Falls? Yeah, just under the falls there's a great pool. At this time of year it's quite chilly, but it's a good way of cooling off after the climb up.
录音提到“lots of them”，这里的代词“them”指代前一句刚提到的“flowers”，直接对应题干的“Lots of”。
你可能会因为答案句用了代词而跟丢，做这类题必须顺着代词往回找它替换的核心名词。
And if you're interested in flowers, it's a really good walk. You'll see lots of them.
录音中的“signs along the path telling you all about”对应题目中的“Signs about the”，紧接着说出的“history”即为正确答案。
你可能听到“mine”就想直接填，但题目中已经有了“of the mine”，要避免重复填写已知信息，注意听从属关系。
And the Coal Mine Walk? Do you actually go down a mine? No, it's closed down now, but there are signs along the path telling you all about the mine's history.

McGrady Falls Trail
•   Will be given a with a ticket
•   Can buy a picnic from the at the entrance
•   Catch direct bus: number
•   Get off bus at the

analyses.content: 录音提到“pay your entry fee”（买票）时会“give you one”，这里的“one”指代前半句刚说过的“map”。
你可能会听到“entrance fee”或“ticket”等背景词就急于填写，要注意听清随着票“被给予的物品”到底是什么。

Is there anything else I should know about it? Things to take and so on? Well, I should tell you there's an entrance fee for the trail, for maintenance, et cetera. It's, uh, ten dollars for adults, and you'll need a map because the walk's not guided, but they'll give you one when you pay your entry fee.
录音中“get that from the café”对应题目中的“buy a picnic from the”，后面的“at the beginning”则同义替换了“entrance”。
你可能会填成“trail”，但“trail”是小径本身，买野餐的实体地点是前置词“café”。
And I'd like to take a picnic. The best thing is to get that from the café at the beginning of the trail. They'll pack it all up for you.
录音明确指出“two-seven-nine”这趟车能“take you directly to...”，精准对应题干的“direct bus”。
你可能会把最先听到的数字“268”当成答案，但录音紧接着用“wouldn't take you there directly”排除了这个干扰项。

Will the bus that stops at the front of the hotel take me there? That's the number two-six-eight bus. It wouldn't take you there directly. It's best if you walk down to the market, and then you can catch the number two-seven-nine there. It'll take you directly to the start of the trail.
题目问在哪里下车（get off），录音中回答“stop at the lake”，所以直接提取“lake”。
你可能会顺手写下“driver”，但这是你需要询问的人，而不是下车的具体地理位置。
And will it be easy to tell when to get off? You need to ask the bus driver to stop at the lake.
